config.note: v42 counts more than 50 clearly changed full-resolution pixels as a visible effect, so small label changes (OsmAnd's search radius) are not mistaken for no progress. v41: the Skill reminder and file state that an empty search result needs INCREASE SEARCH RADIUS, not SHOW ON MAP or zooming. v40: with the Skill enabled, every step's user message restates the waypoint search terms (the system-prompt Skill alone was not followed). v39 keeps the goal turn plus the latest 19 executed turns in each request (an 88-step run hit the provider's prompt limit), stops when a block of 2-6 actions repeats three times in a row, and lets the OsmAnd Skill list each waypoint's search term. v38 allows ten unchanged Waits in a row (was five): a cold OsmAnd start after the snapshot restore showed its logo for over 40 s on the software-rendered emulator. v37 allows 60 s per typed word (was 10 s): OsmAnd searches on every character and one word exceeded 10 s on the software-rendered emulator. v36 bounds unchanged Wait actions separately (stop after five in a row) so a slow splash screen is not mistaken for a no-progress cycle; other actions keep the v29 cycle stop. v35 confirms each screen-recorder clip survives encoder start-up (1.5 s) before GUI actions resume and starts a new clip otherwise (observed: 'unable to configure video/avc codec ... err=-38'); agent behaviour unchanged from v31. v31 resolves Launch names like upstream Open-AutoGLM (case/spacing-insensitive; a translated non-Latin name resolves only when exactly one app is allowed) and stops on all-black screenshots as a rendering infrastructure error. v30 adds SimpleCalendarAddOneEvent (medium) and OsmAndTrack (hard) with visible completion rules and initial step/time budgets of about 2x and 1.5x their 17/60 reference steps, to be revised from learning trials; Calendar verifier rows are withheld from model inputs. v29 follows pinned Open-AutoGLM English contract and sourced Android World guidance. data.goal: Save a track with waypoints Bendern, Liechtenstein, Balzers, Liechtenstein, Oberplanken, Liechtenstein, Nendeln, Liechtenstein in the OsmAnd maps app in the same order as listed.

data:
The phone is on the home screen. To start creating a track in OsmAnd, first launch the OsmAnd app. There is no OsmAnd icon visible here, so I will use the Launch action.


do(action="Launch", app="osmand")

The OsmAnd app is loading ( splash screen). I need to wait for it to finish loading before proceeding to the next step.


do(action="Wait", duration="1 seconds")

The OsmAnd app is now open and showing the map. To start creating a track, I need to open the search function. The Search button is the magnifying glass icon at [134,59,241,108]. I will tap it to begin searching for the first waypoint "Bendern".


do(action="Tap", element=[187,83])

The search panel is open and the EditText field is focused ("Type to search all"). I need to type the first waypoint name "Bendern" to search for it.


do(action="Type", text="Bendern")

The search result for "Bendern" is shown with a "SHOW ON MAP" button. To add this place as the first waypoint, I need to open its place details by tapping the "SHOW ON MAP" button at [0,115,999,168].


do(action="Tap", element=[499,141])

The map is now centered on Bendern, Liechtenstein. To add this location as the first waypoint in the track, I need to open the "Plan a route" menu. The "Back" button at [0,50,135,113] will take me back to the search results where I can access the route planning option from the place details.


do(action="Tap", element=[67,83])

The search result for "Bendern" is still not showing any place. To proceed, I need to increase the search radius by tapping the "INCREASE SEARCH RADIUS" button at [286,315,711,367] until a result appears.
